title: Controlled Hard Climbing
subtitle: Hard stimulus, clean movement, no compensation
context: Tuesday football added unfamiliar leg and cardio load.
Wednesday was skipped due to poor sleep and numbness.
Today is serious training, but not a maximal board benchmark day.
Week 1 priority: calibration, recruitment, timing and confidence.
successCriteria: Confidence slightly higher than at arrival

phases.name: Full warm-up
phases.objective: Prepare fully and test the right mid-back before loading.
tasks: 4–6 easy commercial boulders, gradually increasing difficulty
phases.decisionRule: If the right mid-back stays completely quiet, proceed. If it returns, switch to easy commercial climbing and skip the board.

phases.name: Hard but controlled board climbing
phases.objective: One useful hard-board stimulus without benchmark chasing.
tasks: Choose Kilter or Tension Board—whichever feels more predictable
targets: Send one problem that requires effort
OR make meaningful progress on two harder problems
stopConditions: Feet repeatedly cut for no technical reason
The same move gets worse across attempts
Fingers, elbows or back begin talking
You start compensating because Wednesday was missed
phases.coachingNote: Failing whites or old Kilter grades is not evidence that strength disappeared. Today is about restoring recruitment, timing and confidence.

phases.name: Commercial climbing / movement volume
phases.objective: Add movement variety without more limit pulling.
tasks: Prefer styles different from the board

phases.name: Short physique finisher
tasks: Core: hanging knee raises 3 × 8–10 only if back remains quiet
